title: Confidential Gatekeeper configuration
description: YAML config of the user-side attesting proxy (default path ~/.config/confidential-gatekeeper/config.yaml). See docs/adr/ADR-003-gatekeeper-trust-model.md.

trustedRoots.description: Global list of manually trusted PKI roots — the 'Trusted Clouds'. A bundle's certChain must terminate in one of them (matched by SHA-256 of the DER), or in a root that `attestedRoots` accepts on its own TEE evidence. May be empty while `attestedRoots.enabled` is true.

attestedRoots.description: Second trust anchor: accept a root certificate whose own TEE evidence proves it is a Super Swarm root, without the user listing it. The hardware report must verify against the CPU vendor's built-in root, its reportData must commit to the certificate's public key, and the normalised mrEnclave must carry a Super Protocol signature checked against a key pinned in the binary. Fails closed: a registry that cannot be consulted denies.

registryBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the signed-measurement registry. This only moves the mirror: the signing key is pinned in the binary either way.

cacheTtl.description: How long one root's verdict is reused before the check runs again.

requireNetworkType.description: Whether the root's declared network type must be "trusted". Today's Swarm Cloud root declares "untrusted" — the platform's own network split, not a judgement about the CA — so the default accepts either and reports which one it was.

checkRevocations.description: Also consult the CPU vendor's certificate revocation lists. This needs the network and is reported separately from report integrity, so it is opt-in.

policies.description: User Rego policies, loaded for every endpoint and ANDed with the built-in default pin policy. Each file must declare a distinct package with an `allow` rule.

defaults.description: Defaults applied to every endpoint unless overridden there.

endpoints.description: Local listeners, each verifying and proxying to one router endpoint (hostname).

admin.description: Optional local status API of a running gatekeeper (/healthz, /status, /endpoints, /verdicts, /metrics). It answers with verdicts, so it may only bind a unix socket or a loopback address.

audit.description: Optional audit log: one JSON object per line, appended, recording every verdict and every blocked request. Request and response bodies are never written to it.

file.description: Path to the JSON-lines audit log (relative to the config file). Created if missing, appended to otherwise.

name.description: Lower-case identifier; used as the Rego key (`data.gatekeeper.trust.endpoints[<name>]`).

adminListenAddr.description: unix:<path>, or a loopback host:port such as 127.0.0.1:9465. The admin API exposes verdicts and is local-only.

evidenceDigest.description: Pinned evidenceDigest. Canonical form is sha256/<base64url, unpadded>; sha256/<hex>, sha256:<hex> and bare hex are accepted and normalised at load time. A 32-byte digest leaves the last sextet's two trailing bits clear, so only AEIMQUYcgkosw048 can end the base64url form — the other 48 characters are a second spelling of the same bytes, and pins are compared as exact strings.

pem.description: Inline PEM of the root certificate.

pemFile.description: Path to a PEM file (relative to the config file).

file.description: Path to a Rego v1 module (relative to the config file).

failMode.description: closed: reject requests (503) while there is no valid verdict. open: proxy anyway, log a warning and flag the client-facing response.

verdictCacheTtl.description: On-demand re-checks reuse a verdict younger than this.

maxBundleAge.description: Reject bundles whose issuedAt is older than this.

initialTimeout.description: How long the first request waits for the initial verdict.

upstream.description: Router endpoint base URL. Must be https; the hostname is what the evidence bundle is fetched from and bound to.

trustedEvidence.description: Pinned evidenceDigest values accepted for this endpoint. At least one — there is no trust-on-first-use.
